subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional append?: boolean on the existing write tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well supported, but the permanent model-facing tool contract and backend operation shape are maintainer-owned API decisions.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve append?: boolean on write as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once the branch is refreshed and exact-head CI is clean.

options.title: Request a separate append API
options.body: Ask the PR to switch to a dedicated append tool or explicit mode field if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a replacement branch proves the same behavior with a safer review surface and real proof.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve append?: boolean on write as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once the branch is refreshed and exact-head CI is clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal for the agent tool contract and adjacent gateway/session boundary touched here.
